engine/project_leap_2d/__main__.py.rationale: Remove the superseded standalone workspace entry point; the desktop application runs project_leap_2d.desktop_adapter.

engine/project_leap_2d/analysis_controll.rationale: Remove CLI-triggered Cellpose bypass, workload-only early exit and debug output branch. The default workload failure diagnostic, limit enforcement, 90-candidate calculation, raw-channel projection, Fiji review and publication remain.

engine/project_leap_2d/analysis_modes/gf.rationale: Remove debug-only returns and detector/analyzer substitution arguments with no production caller. Call the existing default InstanSeg detector and GFAP analyzer directly; preserve scientific configurations, quality checks and actual handoff callbacks.

engine/project_leap_2d/analysis_workflow.rationale: Remove GFAP debug preview generation and forwarding of bypass flags. Preserve GFAP route validation, compartment evidence, selected measurement loading, Fiji editing and publication.

engine/project_leap_2d/command_line.py.rationale: Remove nonproduction CLI options and their dedicated diagnostic-path override; retain input/output, Fiji launcher, and review timeout.

engine/project_leap_2d/desktop_adapter.p.rationale: Remove automatic review bypass and test workflow injection. The entry point always invokes the existing scientific workflow; tests patch the module externally. Recognize schema-4 shared model declarations and record the verified selected science-runtime identity; numerical workflow and models are unchanged.

engine/project_leap_2d/fiji_review/resou.rationale: Require the existing chooseAction dialog in every review iteration. All review actions, linked editing, raw measurements and final ROI serialization remain byte-identical.

engine/project_leap_2d/fiji_review/revie.rationale: Remove automatic-continue protocol parameter and manifest field; retain ROI partition validation, projections, calibration and manual-review outputs.

engine/project_leap_2d/maintenance/boots.rationale: Remove the obsolete standalone environment maintenance/install chain. Current runtime seed preparation reads the external validated runtime and uses app.leap_desktop.maintenance; no retained source imports or reads this file.

engine/project_leap_2d/nuclei/dapi_3d_in.rationale: Remove workload-only parameter and early exits. Keep the default enforce mode, resource-limit thresholds, diagnostic writer, object reconstruction/evaluation and ownership calculations.

engine/project_leap_2d/nuclei/instanseg_.rationale: Remove the explicitly test-only cache reset function. Preserve every model resource, metadata/hash verification, inference setting, loading/cache operation and nucleus detection function.

engine/project_leap_2d/runtime_manifest..rationale: Update only the integrity hash of the reviewer resource after removing its automatic review bypass. Keep module order, required symbols, canonical source identifier and trim-resource hash.

engine/project_leap_2d/settings.py.rationale: Remove only five filenames used exclusively by deleted debug outputs. All scientific constants, thresholds, resource limits and production output names remain unchanged.

engine/project_leap_2d/workspace/input_c.rationale: Remove input-to-Trash utilities consumed only by the deleted standalone workspace launcher/recovery chain. Desktop tasks retain their working inputs.
Remove the source-to-Trash recovery chain consumed only by the deleted standalone launcher. Retain production publication recovery and workspace validation.

engine/project_leap_2d/workspace_launche.rationale: Remove the superseded standalone workspace execution and source-to-Trash workflow. Desktop execution and publication use desktop_adapter and the retained workspace transaction modules.

engine/project_leap_2d/desktop_paths.py.rationale: Validate the explicitly selected shared science-runtime root, declared dependency, descriptor, manifest and Python executable; preserve combined-runtime ownership checks for existing schemas.

verification.scope: Static source comparison, synthetic workflow/control tests, and actual packaged InstanSeg resource integrity; no biological image inference or live Fiji run.
